s2:Chemical Analysis of the Brightest Star of the Cetus II Ultrafaint Dwarf Galaxy
s2:Study of the Astrophysical Origins of Chemical Elements in Two Apparently-single

rationale: Papers 2606.28561, 2202.09739, and 2506.14991 provide evidence and constraints on potential sites for r-process nucleosynthesis, including supernovae and collapsars, contributing to the understanding of where r-process elements are produced, but do not fully settle the question.
